remarks: Amazing opportunity in the heart of SoNo! This unique studio-style unit offers an open and inviting bedroom/living room combination featuring soaring ceilings, exposed brick, and distinctive architectural character. The kitchen includes a convenient breakfast bar, while the full bath features a tub/shower combination. In-unit laundry hookups add everyday convenience. A reserved parking space plus ample visitor parking-a rare find in this sought-after area-complete the package.  Enjoy an unbeatable location within walking distance to everything Washington Street has to offer, including trendy restaurants, cafes, shops, and waterfront attractions. Conveniently located near the SoNo Metro-North station for easy access to NYC and close to major highways. Urban living, character, and convenience come together in this one-of-a-kind SoNo unit. Schedule your private viewing before it's gone!
